style: Radiance remains an unmistakably adult fictional heroine, age 21, with a fresh youthful beauty-editorial face and bold Scorpion Generation energy. Hero Atlas is fashion first, purposeful movement second, and an extraordinary earthly world third. Her core brand language is matte black, white, molten gold, and mirror-reflective tailoring: skin-baring crop architecture, sculptural pencil skirts, fashion stilettos, and prominent tasteful scorpion or thorned-rose symbolism. Keep every silhouette fully opaque, securely fitted for its action, non-explicit, and suitable for a public project archive. Every scene must have a distinct action, camera language, and visible heroic objective.
